name: B10-0524/2025 (Renew) – Post-election killings and the deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania, including the case of imprisoned opposition leader Tundu Lissu
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-election killings and deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania, including the case of imprisoned opposition leader Tundu Lissu
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the violent crackdown on protests after Tanzania's October 2025 elections, in which hundreds died and many were arrested. It calls for an end to the violence, the release of jailed opposition leader Tundu Lissu, and fair trials for opponents and protesters. It also asks for an independent investigation into human rights abuses, and for the European Union to pause direct support to the Tanzanian government while still funding civil society groups.

- The European Union is asked to pause direct support to Tanzania's government, but not to civil society groups.
- Tanzania's government and security forces are urged to stop the crackdown and release Tundu Lissu.
- An independent outside investigation into election-related abuses is requested, with those responsible held to account.
